company.shortDescription: CRYSP Farms operates on-site vertical farms using hydroponics and AI to grow and supply fresh produce with minimal waste.
company.description: CRYSP Farms, founded in Dubai in 2019, builds and operates on-site vertical farms for clients such as hotels and retailers. It uses hydroponic systems and AI to grow crops efficiently and deliver fresh produce with minimal waste. In 2024, the company raised $2.25 million to support its expansion.
